* focus on the main content

Scene description:

scenes.caption: This scene opens with the University of Wyoming Extension logo and its "From the Ground Up" branding. It then shows detailed close-ups of a wasp nest, highlighting its intricate hexagonal cells and larvae. The scene shifts to a man inside an unfinished wooden greenhouse, gesturing and speaking as he explains the construction. Interspersed are shots of wasps actively building and tending to their nest on a tree branch. The scene concludes with the man demonstrating various aspects of the greenhouse build, often holding tools or materials.

This scene from a University of Wyoming Extension video demonstrates the process of removing a wasp or bee nest from a wooden structure. It begins by showing the honeycomb nest situated in a corner, likely within a wall or attic cavity. The removal process is then depicted, using tools such as a rusty metal blade and a wooden scraper to carefully extract the nest from the wood. The scene concludes with a worker using a hammer on a wooden beam, suggesting final repairs or cleanup after the nest has been extracted.

This scene features a man in a University of Wyoming Extension shirt, who appears to be an instructor or expert, presenting on-site at a wooden structure under construction. He directly addresses the camera, likely explaining the building process or a specific technique. The scene then shows him working intently inside the partially built framework, carefully using a brush, possibly for applying a sealant or finish. His focused demeanor and the setting suggest a practical demonstration or educational segment about carpentry or sustainable building practices, highlighting hands-on construction work.

This scene features a University of Wyoming Extension educator, likely Jeff Edwards, presenting from inside a wooden greenhouse or similar structure. He gestures toward the framework and walls, using a long tool to demonstrate construction features or gardening techniques. The presentation then shifts to related topics, showing close-up footage of a wasp nest and honeycombs to discuss insect structures, and cuts to a well-stocked shelf of pest control products. The educator is also seen holding and explaining a honeycomb frame. The scene concludes with the program's standard credit and title cards, acknowledging the production team and additional footage sources.
